tasks.subject: Task 1 (S1): offload ChunkText off the model-service event loop
tasks.description:
**Goal:** ChunkText runs chunk_text via loop.run_in_executor(None, ...) so it no longer blocks the asyncio event loop.

**Files:** modify apps-microservices/embedding-model-service/infrastructure/grpc_server.py; create apps-microservices/embedding-model-service/tests/test_chunktext_offload.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps-microservices/embedding-model-service/infrastructure/grpc_server.py", "apps-microservices/embedding-model-service/tests/test_chunktext_offload.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest apps-microservices/embedding-model-service/tests/test_chunktext_offload.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["chunk_text offloaded via run_in_executor(None)", "identical chunks returned", "INTERNAL error branch preserved"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2 (C1): shared persistent gRPC channel in embedding_client
tasks.description:
**Goal:** all 5 client functions reuse one lazily-created persistent channel (keepalive) instead of per-call channels.

**Files:** modify libs/common-utils/src/common_utils/grpc_clients/embedding_client.py; modify libs/common-utils/tests/test_embedding_grpc_client.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["libs/common-utils/src/common_utils/grpc_clients/embedding_client.py", "libs/common-utils/tests/test_embedding_grpc_client.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest libs/common-utils/tests/test_embedding_grpc_client.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["insecure_channel called once across N calls", "all 5 functions reuse shared channel", "keepalive options set", "no async with teardown", "re-raise/graceful-empty contract preserved"]}
```
